metadata.title: Marvell’s New Chief Financial Officer Sold Stock. Then the AI Rout Hit.<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Marvell’s New Chief Financial Officer Sold Stock. Then the AI Rout Hit.
Shares of Marvell Technology pulled back amid a wider tech downturn, just days after the company’s newly appointed finance chief executed his first open-market stock sale.
